title: Anchor - Habit & Focus
features: Daily habits with streaks and progress tracking
App blocking and limits via Apple Screen Time (FamilyControls, ManagedSettings, DeviceActivity)
Focus timer and stopwatch for productivity sessions
Custom shield screen when opening a blocked app
Insights: focus hours, screen time saved, habit completion

bottomTabBar.note: Flat white bar, hairline top border. Active tab: aubergine #4A154B icon + label with small gold #ECB22E dot above icon. Inactive: #8F7D90.

sharedComponents.statusBar: iOS status bar 9:41, safe area top 59px
sharedComponents.controls: Primary button: pill, #4A154B fill, white Lato 600 label, pressed #3F1240, disabled #E6DEE6 with #8F7D90 label. Secondary: pill, white fill, 1.5px #4A154B border. Input: 12px radius, #EADCEA border, focus 2px #4A154B ring, error #DC2626. Card: white, 20px radius, soft shadow. Chip: pill, #F3EAF3 fill, #4A154B text; selected = #4A154B fill white text.
